issue_text: Setting timeout=None should disable timeouts consistently across request handling instead of falling back to the default timeout behavior.
An Authorization header is being stripped during HTTPS redirects even when it should be preserved.
Digest authentication should correctly support RFC 2069 challenges that do not provide qop.
NO_PROXY matching should correctly support IPv4 addresses, IPv6 addresses, and localhost.
Empty zstd-encoded responses should decode cleanly instead of raising a decoder error.
